Algor's Axe of Global Warming Protection
Piece:  Weapon
Type:  One-handed Axe
Class:  Fighter
Damage:  varies with item level

Algor's Axe of Global Warming Protection is a fighter one-handed axe.

This item is soulbound.

This rainbow is specific to Algor the Cold's lair chest. It is not in the shared mythic pool every boss rolls. The Wishing Well can also spit it out once you are high enough for that dungeon. The full list is on Boss Lair Rainbows.

Attributes:

The base item always carries:

  • + Agility
  • + Intellect
  • + Strength
  • + Total Health
  • + Fire Damage Resistance
  • + Ice Damage
  • + % Enemy Stun Chance

Rolled copies can also pick up an extra ending. Those endings and their bonuses are listed on Mythic Suffixes.
